rule: Any candidate used to develop/debug the technical validation pipeline, where source/test/patch behavior or raw test results were inspected, is permanently excluded from the confirmatory sample irrespective of outcome. The exclusion is methodological, not a judgment that the upstream bug is invalid.

categories.evidence: Earlier metadata/test/patch feasibility and smoke work recorded in the research branch; see DATA_FEASIBILITY.md.
Targets and raw test signals were used while developing and auditing the first no-inference technical triage workflow.

This batch exposed source/test behavior while the runner, shell activation, dependency setup and artifact checks were still being debugged. Exclude this entire batch even if a later artefact shows a technically promising pair.

The V2 first-eight batch was used to diagnose missing pytest and setup/artifact issues. PySnooper-2 lacked pytest on both sides; spaCy-1 never reached test execution. Exclude the batch independent of any test outcome.

This batch was used to validate the pytest bootstrap and diagnose a parser that rejected whitespace in a fixed-commit metadata line. The parser has since been corrected. Exclude the batch independent of any test outcome.

This batch was used to diagnose missing project test dependencies and runner bootstrap behavior. The inspected Matplotlib-2 log shows numpy is missing before test collection; the PySnooper-3 log shows python_toolbox is missing before test collection. Neither is a valid bug-specific test pair. Exclude the entire batch independent of any other outcome.

This batch was used to validate the pinned runtime, target-test execution, paired raw logs and artifact audit. Seven artifacts show buggy-fail/fixed-pass signals; Httpie-4 fails on both sides. All eight are permanently excluded from confirmatory use because the batch was used to validate the technical screening workflow, independent of outcomes.

next_action: V6 is the active metadata-only intake, skipping 40 prior-exposure/debug cases. Use its frozen queue order for normal technical case screening; review raw artifacts, then require source/license, root-cause ground truth, evidence-sufficiency, leakage and independent human-review gates. No case is auto-accepted; no model inference is authorized.
rationale: Do not reuse these candidates as confirmatory evidence; do not silently reinsert them into the queue. Technical pass/fail is not case acceptance.
